No class weighting needed. Three labels: det-preferred (~38%), internal-preferred (~1-2%), no-preference (~60%). Data reuse: prescreening 5 eps/task + MVP 20 eps/task directly count toward totals. Only collect additional episodes to reach 20/task/modality. vLLM backend on both GPUs.\\n\", \"registry_id\": \"plan-001b-gpu0\", \"status\": \"DONE\", \"conclusion\": \"failed\"}, {\"id\": \"plan-002\", \"claim\": \"C2\", \"description\": \"Router SFT training. KEY: This confirms/denies C1's \\\"selective > unconditional\\\" sub-claim (Reviewer W1).\\n\", \"priority\": \"P0\", \"gpu_budget_hours\": 15, \"deps\": [\"plan-002\"], \"notes\": \"CogRouter (84.6) and ITP-R (62.58) cited from papers, not reproduced. def _generate_api(self, messages, temperature):
    payload = {

        "temperature": temperature,
        "max_tokens": self.max_tokens,
    }
    for attempt in range(3):

            resp.raise_for_status()
